ForgeMCP Stage 2E-T — Controlled Isolated Load Preflight

Date: October 23, 2026
Verdict: BLOCKED — PRODUCTION CLEAN-STATE GATE FAILED
Test Editor launches this stage: 0. No new clone created.

Subsequent owner-requested dirty-package recheck — October 23, 2026

The earlier blocked verdict below is retained as historical evidence. Fresh session discovery and project authentication reconfirmed [session id redacted], [local path]

Ultra Dynamic Weather (9/UX/QWIT4Q5JJ8585ENBY5400I), Ultra Dynamic Sky (C/AE/BK2M8Y8Y4ILGBJFC22SJCA), and PlayerStart (F/26/359XHJOPQAURYFVANTMBAM) are no longer reported dirty in this complete loaded-package snapshot. Zero dirty production Content packages were observed. This removes the previously observed dirty-Content blocker; it does not by itself establish full Stage 2E-T readiness or disk-load acceptance. The tool cannot classify unloaded packages as clean. No source hashes, Landscape state or clone/DDC gates were rerun as part of this targeted recheck.

Evidence: Fresh native dirty snapshot [not indexed], inventory 871D430E41905280C3311B931255779B. No save, reload, restart, restore, new clone or test launch was performed. Separate explicit owner approval remains required before any test Editor launch.

1. Execution boundary

The owner explicitly required complete safety preflight and separate explicit approval before launching one disposable Editor. Phase 2 requires no dirty production Content packages and directs execution to stop if production integrity cannot be established. Fresh native inspection found three dirty production external actor packages. Preparation therefore stops before Phase 3 clone creation, DDC configuration changes or any Editor launch. No approval to launch is requested while this gate fails.

2. Authenticated production identity

Fresh ForgeMCP discovery and project_info authenticated [session id redacted] / PID [redacted], [local path]

3. Blocking dirty-package inventory

The complete read-only snapshot inspected 1,244 loaded packages and returned five dirty packages, with no further pages or inspection errors. Three are production Content:

Actor owner Dirty production package
Ultra Dynamic Weather /Game/ExternalActors/Levels/L_City_World_Master/9/UX/QWIT4Q5JJ8585ENBY5400I
Ultra Dynamic Sky /Game/ExternalActors/Levels/L_City_World_Master/C/AE/BK2M8Y8Y4ILGBJFC22SJCA
PlayerStart /Game/ExternalActors/Levels/L_City_World_Master/F/26/359XHJOPQAURYFVANTMBAM

Each package has resolved active-level external actor ownership, is_dirty=true and package_newly_created=false. Their cause and intended edits are unknown; no causal attribution is made. The two other dirty packages are /Script/SlateCore and /Script/UnrealEd, both verified compiled-in engine-script packages. No dirty flag was cleared and no save or restore was attempted.

The three production packages' current disk files still match the post-adoption checkpoint. This distinguishes newly observed unsaved state from a demonstrated disk-file change; it does not establish what their in-memory edits contain.

Landscape dirty / layers up to date false / true

Native preflight reports target_layer_ready=true, requires_layer_setup=false and the sole prior adoption ID [redacted] as approved=true, used=true, expired=true. There is no pending adoption request in that response. No new request was made. The available responses do not expose a complete enumeration of all terrain jobs; a global no-pending-operation assertion is not claimed. No job or mutation was dispatched here.

5. Recovery and disk checks

All three manifest SHA-256 pins matched their established values:

  • Stage 1 external manifest: d9de66d61745427b313c5ee7eb5a1f2238d8c76ca2dc5aa0cd277929bbac3388.
  • Native adoption manifest: e7e95ea63026d16a2c829a5cb9e90eda5633175f35e65075f84235604969123f.
  • Post-adoption manifest: c3ec68f538425c600bc10981e0ad519d35371a3920839f2c722b1a3e1b861fc1.

All 32 original Stage 1 backup files match recorded SHA-256. All 23 native backup files match Stage 1 SHA-256 and native manifest MD5. All 32 post-adoption current source/backup pairs match recorded SHA-256, including the 17 saved Landscape packages. Production world/external namespace membership remains exactly 23 files, with no additions or missing files. Neither original checkpoint nor the post-adoption checkpoint was modified.

Free storage at audit: 185,443,733,504 bytes, approximately 172.71 GiB. Storage is not the immediate blocker. No full 1,743-file clone audit or runtime dependency acceptance was performed after the production gate failed.

6. Forensic review and DDC assessment

Read Saved/ForgeMCP_Stage2ER_IsolatedEditor_Startup_Forensics.md and Saved/ForgeMCP_Landscape_Stage2E_Persistence_Acceptance.md. The former corrects the latter's earlier overstatement: the !GUsingNullRHI block loads SlateRHIRenderer, not LevelEditor. Historical evidence identifies TedsOutliner requesting an unloaded LevelEditor module; the offscreen attempt remains an unresolved startup timeout, not a demonstrated Landscape serialization failure.

Fresh installed-source reads reconfirmed DerivedDataBackends.cpp selection by -DDC=, named-graph failure falling back to InstalledDerivedDataBackendGraph/DerivedDataBackendGraph, and FileSystemCacheStore.cpp path precedence: declared environment hook, then HKCU override, then declared command-line hook, then declared Editor-setting hook. A future private literal-path node must omit those override hooks and redirection; both fallback roots must reach only the same private writable store and optional read-only engine pak. These definitions were not applied during this blocked stage. No effective runtime graph is claimed.

7. Preserved state and next gate

[local path]

Owner review of the three dirty production packages is required before resuming. Their edits must not be discarded or saved automatically. A later fresh preflight must satisfy the zero-dirty-Content gate, verify the remaining operation/isolation/dependency gates and prepare the exact clone/command for explicit owner launch approval. The current stage provides no launch authorization and no persistence acceptance.

Evidence:

  • Complete native production inspection [not indexed].
  • Per-file checkpoint verification and namespace audit [not indexed].
  • Read-only hash audit helper [not indexed].

BLOCKED — PRODUCTION CLEAN-STATE GATE FAILED. The saved Landscape bytes and current Landscape readback match the accepted post-save baseline; unrelated unsaved production actors prevent progression under the owner's stated preflight requirements.
